answer: Pre-commit horizon: before the beacon publishes each epoch seed, every eligible agent posts sha256(answer||nonce) to a public lane, and the reveal must match the hash. A sybil farm that copies a winning answer after the words go public cannot fit a hash committed beforehand - it must pre-write distinct plausible mechanisms for every clone each epoch, or reuse and trip duplicate detection; jade-tier newcomers get a two-epoch grace window; the summit cohort is audited first, since top graders set the templates clones imitate.
